structuredContent.content:
name: PoN W1 work security observations
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - trillionnium/**
      - tests/fuzz/**
      - scripts/ci/**
      - scripts/pon_w1_*.py
      - formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/work_query_bound.py
      - formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/test_work_query_bound.py
      - config/**
      - .cargo/**
      - rust-toolchain.toml
      - .github/workflows/pon-w1-work-security.yml
      - .github/workflows/pon-recent-batch-acceptance.yml
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: pon-w1-security-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  # A later source never erases a failed or partial earlier observation.
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  CI: "true"
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
  RUST_TEST_THREADS: "1"
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
jobs:
  false-trace-reuse:
    name: W1 false trace reuse (${{ matrix.arch }}, ${{ matrix.source }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 55
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        arch: [x64, arm64]
        source: [head, prospective-merge]
        include:
          - arch: x64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
          - arch: arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    env:
      TRNM_COST_RUNNER_LABEL: ${{ matrix.runner }}
      SOURCE_KIND: ${{ matrix.source }}
      EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      EXPECTED_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact measured source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.EXPECTED_SOURCE }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Reserve observations and verify ordered source identity
        id: source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out="$RUNNER_TEMP/w1-security-$SOURCE_KIND-${{ matrix.arch }}-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          mkdir "$out"
          printf 'OUT=%s\n' "$out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s\n' "$out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-w1-security\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-w1-security\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_SOURCE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$out/source-before.json"
          bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit 2>&1 | tee "$out/preflight.log"
      - name: Install exact original compiler and tools
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - name: Execute reader rejection controls
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/ci/test_pon_w1_false_trace_reuse_reader_v1.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/reader-controls.log"
          python3 scripts/ci/test_work_rejection_report.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/retained-rejection-reader-controls.log"
          python3 scripts/ci/test_run_w1_false_trace_reuse_v1.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/runner-controls.log"
          python3 formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/test_work_query_bound.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/query-work-controls.log"
      - name: Verify actual locked graph and formatting
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo +1.95.0 metadata --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml --format-version 1 > "$OUT/cargo-graph.json"
          cargo +1.95.0 fmt --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml --all -- --check 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/format.log"
      - name: Run complete W1 module tests and strict primitive lint
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --release --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-crypto-primitives --lib pon_work:: -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/w1-tests.log"
          python3 - "$OUT/w1-tests.log" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, sys
          text = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
          rows = re.findall(r'^test result: ok\. ([0-9]+) passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;', text, re.M)
          if len(rows) != 1 or int(rows[0]) < 104:
              raise SystemExit('complete retained W1 module suite did not execute')
          PY
          cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --release --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --test work_fuzz_semantics -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/w1-fuzz-semantics.log"
          python3 - "$OUT/w1-fuzz-semantics.log" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, sys
          text = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
          rows = re.findall(r'^test result: ok\. ([0-9]+) passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;', text, re.M)
          if rows != ['6']:
              raise SystemExit('six retained W1 fuzz semantic controls did not execute')
          PY
          cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --release --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-crypto-primitives --example pon_rejection_cost -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/retained-rejection-tests.log"
          python3 - "$OUT/retained-rejection-tests.log" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, sys
          text = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
          rows = re.findall(r'^test result: ok\. ([0-9]+) passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;', text, re.M)
          if rows != ['3']:
              raise SystemExit('three retained rejection controls did not execute')
          PY
          cargo +1.95.0 clippy --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-crypto-primitives --lib --tests -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/w1-clippy.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 clippy --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-crypto-primitives --example pon_rejection_cost -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/retained-rejection-clippy.log"
      - name: Execute complete false trace reuse campaign
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        # This frozen release runner rejects even a workflow-wide incremental
        # override of zero. Preserve that guard and use the default release input.
        run: env -u CARGO_INCREMENTAL python3 scripts/ci/run_w1_false_trace_reuse_v1.py --arch "${{ matrix.arch }}"
      - name: Execute additional complete full-limb comparison
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        run: env -u CARGO_INCREMENTAL python3 scripts/ci/run_w1_false_trace_reuse_v1.py --arch "${{ matrix.arch }}" --full-limb
      - name: Verify measured source after execution
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_SOURCE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$OUT/source-after.json"
      - name: Retain costs, binaries and all failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: w1-false-trace-${{ matrix.source }}-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ env.EXPECTED_SOURCE }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/w1-security-${{ matrix.source }}-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
  legal-strategy:
    name: W1 complete legal strategies (${{ matrix.version }}, ${{ matrix.arch }}, ${{ matrix.source }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 180
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        arch: [x64, arm64]
        source: [head, prospective-merge]
        version: [v1, v2]
        include:
          - arch: x64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
          - arch: arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    env:
      TRNM_COST_RUNNER_LABEL: ${{ matrix.runner }}
      SOURCE_KIND: ${{ matrix.source }}
      LEGAL_VERSION: ${{ matrix.version }}
      LEGAL_CAPTURE_PREFIX: ${{ matrix.version == 'v2' && 'w1-legal-v2' || 'w1-legal' }}
      LEGAL_ARTIFACT_PREFIX: ${{ matrix.version == 'v2' && 'w1-legal-strategy-v2' || 'w1-legal-strategy' }}
      EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      EXPECTED_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact measured source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.EXPECTED_SOURCE }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Reserve observations and verify ordered source identity
        id: source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out="$RUNNER_TEMP/$LEGAL_CAPTURE_PREFIX-$SOURCE_KIND-${{ matrix.arch }}-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          mkdir "$out"
          printf 'OUT=%s\n' "$out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s\n' "$out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-w1-legal\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-w1-legal\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_SOURCE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$out/source-before.json"
          bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit 2>&1 | tee "$out/preflight.log"
      - name: Install exact original compiler and tools
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - name: Verify complete legal-cost readers and native controls
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/ci/test_pon_w1_legal_strategy_reader_v1.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/legal-reader-controls.log"
          python3 scripts/ci/test_pon_w1_legal_strategy_reader_v2.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/legal-reader-v2-controls.log"
          python3 scripts/ci/test_run_w1_false_trace_reuse_v1.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/runner-controls.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 metadata --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml --format-version 1 > "$OUT/cargo-graph.json"
          cargo +1.95.0 fmt --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml --all -- --check 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/format.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --release --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --example pon_w1_legal_strategy_v1 -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/legal-native-controls.log"
          python3 - "$OUT/legal-native-controls.log" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, sys
          text = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
          rows = re.findall(r'^test result: ok\. ([0-9]+) passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;', text, re.M)
          if rows != ['8']:
              raise SystemExit('four retained legal, two versioned legal and two shared material controls did not execute')
          PY
          cargo +1.95.0 clippy --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --example pon_w1_legal_strategy_v1 -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/legal-clippy.log"
      - name: Execute all thirty original-budget legal strategy shards
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mode=--legal-strategy
          if test "$LEGAL_VERSION" = v2; then mode=--legal-strategy-v2; fi
          env -u CARGO_INCREMENTAL python3 scripts/ci/run_w1_false_trace_reuse_v1.py --arch "${{ matrix.arch }}" "$mode"
      - name: Verify measured source after execution
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_SOURCE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$OUT/source-after.json"
      - name: Retain costs, binaries and all failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: ${{ env.LEGAL_ARTIFACT_PREFIX }}-${{ matrix.source }}-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ env.EXPECTED_SOURCE }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/${{ env.LEGAL_CAPTURE_PREFIX }}-${{ matrix.source }}-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
  legal-factorial:
    name: W1 factorial legal strategies v3 (${{ matrix.arch }}, ${{ matrix.source }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 180
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        arch: [x64, arm64]
        source: [head, prospective-merge]
        include:
          - arch: x64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
          - arch: arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    env:
      TRNM_COST_RUNNER_LABEL: ${{ matrix.runner }}
      SOURCE_KIND: ${{ matrix.source }}
      EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      EXPECTED_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact measured source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.EXPECTED_SOURCE }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Reserve observations and verify ordered source identity
        id: source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out="$RUNNER_TEMP/w1-legal-factorial-$SOURCE_KIND-${{ matrix.arch }}-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          mkdir "$out"
          printf 'OUT=%s\n' "$out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s\n' "$out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-w1-legal-factorial\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-w1-legal-factorial\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_SOURCE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$out/source-before.json"
          bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit 2>&1 | tee "$out/preflight.log"
      - name: Install exact original compiler and tools
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - name: Verify retained and factorial readers and command-owner failures
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/ci/test_pon_w1_legal_strategy_reader_v1.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/retained-legal-reader-controls.log"
          python3 scripts/ci/test_pon_w1_legal_strategy_reader_v3.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/factorial-reader-controls.log"
          python3 scripts/ci/test_run_w1_false_trace_reuse_v1.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/runner-controls.log"
          python3 scripts/ci/test_ci_source_integrity.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/source-rejection-controls.log"
      - name: Verify actual locked graph and original formatting
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo +1.95.0 metadata --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml --format-version 1 > "$OUT/cargo-graph.json"
          cargo +1.95.0 fmt --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml --all -- --check 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/format.log"
      - name: Execute native producer, header, History and CPU cancellation controls
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --release --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-crypto-primitives --lib pon_work::legal_attempt:: -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/factorial-kernel-tests.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --release --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --example pon_w1_legal_strategy_v3 -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/factorial-example-tests.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --release --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --test work_header_binding -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/header-binding-tests.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --release --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib history_w1_ -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/history-w1-tests.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --release --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib ingress::history_import::tests:: -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/history-import-tests.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --release --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib ingress::public_v3::scalar_cpu::completion_tests:: -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/cpu-completion-tests.log"
          python3 - "$OUT" <<'PYTEST'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, sys
          root = Path(sys.argv[1])
          # The one ignored History entry is the existing subprocess fixture;
          # its parent control selects real SIGKILL cuts. It is not a skipped gate.
          expected = {"factorial-kernel-tests": (6, 0), "factorial-example-tests": (6, 0),
              "header-binding-tests": (1, 0), "history-w1-tests": (5, 0),
              "history-import-tests": (28, 1), "cpu-completion-tests": (11, 0)}
          for name, counts in expected.items():
              text = (root / (name + ".log")).read_text()
              rows = re.findall(r'^test result: ok\. ([0-9]+) passed; 0 failed; ([0-9]+) ignored;', text, re.M)
              if rows != [tuple(map(str, counts))]:
                  raise SystemExit(name + ': exact native controls did not execute')
          history = (root / 'history-import-tests.log').read_text()
          for name in (
              'final_resource_completion_preserves_error_priority_and_original_deadline',
              'final_resource_expiry_keeps_committed_history_and_settled_cpu',
          ):
              selector = 'ingress::history_import::tests::deadline_controls::' + name
              rows = re.findall(r'^test ' + re.escape(selector) + r' \.\.\. ok$', history, re.M)
              if len(rows) != 1:
                  raise SystemExit(selector + ': exact deadline control did not execute once')
          codec_selector = ('ingress::history_import::tests::'
              'history_codec_snapshot_preserves_legacy_bytes_identity_and_deferred_profile_errors')
          codec_rows = re.findall(r'^test ' + re.escape(codec_selector) + r' \.\.\. ok$', history, re.M)
          if len(codec_rows) != 1:
              raise SystemExit(codec_selector + ': exact codec control did not execute once')
          PYTEST
      - name: Prepare pinned provider required by native all-feature controls
        shell: bash
        run: bash scripts/ci/prepare_pq_provider.sh
      - name: Run strict native lint for all affected owners
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo +1.95.0 clippy --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-crypto-primitives --lib --tests -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/factorial-kernel-clippy.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 clippy --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/factorial-node-clippy.log"
      - name: Execute all thirty separate v3 shards under the original per-shard budget
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        run: env -u CARGO_INCREMENTAL python3 scripts/ci/run_w1_false_trace_reuse_v1.py --arch "${{ matrix.arch }}" --legal-strategy-v3
      - name: Verify measured source after execution
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_SOURCE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$OUT/source-after.json"
      - name: Retain costs, binaries and all failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: w1-legal-factorial-${{ matrix.source }}-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ env.EXPECTED_SOURCE }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/w1-legal-factorial-${{ matrix.source }}-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
  fresh-challenge-service:
    name: W1 fresh challenge service (x64, ${{ matrix.source }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 55
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        source: [head, prospective-merge]
    env:
      SOURCE_KIND: ${{ matrix.source }}
      EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      EXPECTED_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact observed source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.EXPECTED_SOURCE }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Reserve observations and verify ordered source identity
        id: source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out="$RUNNER_TEMP/w1-fresh-service-$SOURCE_KIND-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          mkdir "$out"
          printf 'OUT=%s\n' "$out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s\n' "$out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-w1-fresh\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-w1-fresh\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_SOURCE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$out/source.json"
          bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit 2>&1 | tee "$out/preflight.log"
      - name: Install original pinned compiler
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal
      - name: Run refusal controls for original Host and fresh successor
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/ci/test_from_zero_host_ci.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/original-host-controls.log"
          python3 scripts/ci/test_run_from_zero_native.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/original-native-controls.log"
          python3 scripts/ci/test_run_w1_fresh_service_v1.py 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/fresh-service-controls.log"
      - name: Execute original and fresh service with original Host resources
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        run: python3 scripts/ci/run_from_zero_host.py -- python3 scripts/ci/run_w1_fresh_service_v1.py --out "$OUT/fresh-service"
      - name: Verify observed source after execution
        if: always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_SOURCE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$OUT/source-after.json"
      - name: Retain both service outcomes and original Host evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: w1-fresh-service-${{ matrix.source }}-${{ env.EXPECTED_SOURCE }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/w1-fresh-service-${{ matrix.source }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
